text:
Emma: Quick sync — week-of-launch 'teaser pulse' + webinar invite. Need: send windows by TZ, two subject variants (enterprise / startup), and a small benchmark snippet in the email. Target: +20% opens vs last launch.

Raj: Love it. Two subject options: "What this new runtime means for your app" and "Speed up LLM inference — 3 ways". Prefer the first for enterprise.

Priya: Staggering plan: APAC: Tue 9am local, EMEA: Tue 9am local, NA: Tue 9am local. + backup resend 48h later to non-opens.

Jordan: Benchmarks: last launch open 18%, CTR 3.1%. We should A/B 60/40 control/variant for subject + include a short graph in the email (png). If we hit >22% open, push the follow-up webinar invite to priority segment.

Maya: I'll do a compact header with a one-line stat callout — can we get the stat copy?

Emma: Use Jordan's stat: "Avg latency down 3.4x in our benchmark" — short copy: "See the benchmark that dropped cost 30%". Keep hero CTA: "See benchmarks + join webinar".

Priya: Seg rule for priority webinar invite (high-value):
```
segment: company_size >= 100 || plan == "dedicated"
and recent_activity > 7 days
```
We'll route that to webinar list and to SDRs.

Raj: Copy for startup variant (shorter): "Faster LLMs. Less infra. Try a demo." Include UTM: ?utm_campaign=launch_teaser&utm_source=email.

Emma: Need final signoff on subject lines and send times by EOD. @Jordan can you preflight the send and confirm expected audience counts?

Jordan: Running preflight now. Expect numbers: total send ~42k, priority ~2.8k. Will post results in 30m.

send-bot: Scheduled test send for 3581234660 (internal). Tagging: #launch-week. :white_check_mark:
